deliveryProfile.persona: independent investigative journalist and podcast host
deliveryProfile.style: conversational, grounded, document-driven, skeptical without sounding theatrical or conspiratorial
deliveryProfile.cadence: natural podcast speech with varied sentence rhythm; deliberate on evidence, names, dates, quantities, charges, corrections, and court outcomes
deliveryProfile.energy: controlled and engaged; increase emphasis for consequential contrasts without shouting or adopting an announcer voice
deliveryProfile.pacing: approximately 145 spoken words per minute; allow brief pauses around section turns and important factual corrections
emphasis: slow slightly for names, dates, drug names, quantities, statutes, charges, and sentencing outcomes
use subtle emphasis for contrast words such as alleged, admitted, corrected, pleaded guilty, and no prison time
treat source disclosures and corrections as editorially important rather than boilerplate
avoid: rushing citations, names, numbers, or legal terminology

consent.confirmedBy: project owner (jlucus) on behalf of host
consent.scope: Voice cloning/synthesis of Eric William Nissen's voice for Insight Corruption podcast narration and editing, sourced from his own published social audio.
consent.note: Per AUDIO_GENERATION_PLAN.md Section 7, consent must be recorded before any reference audio is fine-tuned or cloned. This record tracks that approval; it does not itself constitute the audio intake.

referenceAudio.purpose: Canonical zero-shot Chatterbox voice reference for Eric William Nissen. This is not a fine-tuned checkpoint.

selectionProfile.speaker: Eric William Nissen only
selectionProfile.desiredDelivery: natural conversational speech closest to how Eric should host Insight Corruption
selectionProfile.preferredContent: continuous declarative speech with natural phrasing; include enough tonal variation to capture Eric's normal cadence without yelling, music, or performance effects
rejectIf: music or sound effects overlap speech
another speaker or crosstalk is audible
heavy room echo or aggressive noise reduction
telephone-quality or heavily compressed source when a cleaner source exists
whispering, yelling, character voice, or atypical delivery
long silence or fragmented one-word cuts
preprocessing: remove non-speech only when cleanup does not alter the voice
avoid aggressive denoise, pitch correction, time stretching, or formant processing
normalize conservatively and retain an archival copy of the unprocessed source

referenceAudio.source: Eric William Nissen's authorized published social audio; exact source URLs and timestamps must be recorded during intake
referenceAudio.storageLocation: Modal Volume 'underworld-voice-profiles' under clips/eric-nissen/; audio is not committed to Git

notes: Canonical project voice specification for Eric William Nissen. Runtime voice-profile config should inherit these synthesis and delivery constraints, then add resolved Modal reference-clip paths. Consent is confirmed, but synthesis remains blocked until a clean canonical reference clip is selected, provenance is recorded, and the clip is uploaded. Chatterbox zero-shot cloning is the production baseline; fine-tuning is an escalation path, not the default.

training.strategy: Use Chatterbox zero-shot voice cloning first. Do not fine-tune unless controlled listening tests show unacceptable cross-segment identity or cadence drift.
fineTuningGate: same fixed test corpus compared across candidate settings
quality problem documented before training is approved

testCorpus: proper names including Joanne Segovia and Eumi K. Lee
numbers, dates, acronyms, and legal references
repeated phrase across separate chunks to evaluate voice drift
reviewCriteria: appropriate emotional restraint for factual and disputed material
